title: Master & Dynamic Partners with Alcantara for new MH40 Over Ear and MH30 On Ear Headphones | audioXpress
snippet:
Title: Master & Dynamic Partners with Alcantara for new MH40 Over Ear and MH30 On Ear Headphones | audioXpress
headphones neodymium product design lifestyle eco-friendly materials water resistant Master & Dynamic Alcantara carbon-neutral suede-like. # Master & Dynamic Partners with Alcantara for new MH40 Over Ear and MH30 On Ear Headphones. New York lifestyle audio brand, Master & Dynamic, has partnered with Italian company Alcantara to introduce new versions of its popular MH40 Over Ear and MH30 On Ear Headphones. Alcantara is a unique eco-friendly and highly durable luxury material with great possibilities for replacing leather, suede and velvet, allowing for a combination of sensory, aesthetic and functional values. New York City-based audio company, Master & Dynamic, combines sound and creativity in new lifestyle-oriented products, always exploring innovative materials with great attention to aesthetics and functionality. Their latest MH40 Over Ear and MH30 On Ear Headphones are designed to be modern tools for mobile users wishing to stand out from the crowd. We build sound tools for creative minds.” Master & Dynamic headphones seek a natural, detailed, sound signature, tuned to complement a diversity of tastes and musical genres. With a particular attention to materials, maintaining the perfect balance of aesthetics, strength, comfort and utility, the company recently added a new collection of headphones for the winter holidays with special versions of its MH40 and MH30 headphones using Alcantara material that feels like suede. Premium Alcantara material is used on headband exterior and interior surfaces, ear pads, and earcup insets, which contrasts beautifully with the stainless steel components in all high strain areas. The MH30 Alcantara model are foldable supra-aural headphones, using 40mm neodymium drivers (32 ohms) in a lighter (260g) construction, also featuring Premium Alcantara, stainless steel, aluminum and the same two detachable woven cables. The MH30 was designed to be a more mobile “thinking cap” with Alcantara material on headband exterior and interior surfaces, ear pads, and earcup insets. The material covers the headband, ear cups, and ear pads, with the added benefit of keeping the ears warm. The new gunmetal/black Alcantara editions of the MH40 Over Ear and MH30 On Ear headphones are available at specialty sound and retail stores across North America and are available online for $399 and $329, respectively.
